description: This file defines the internal data structures and class for managing directed graph cycles detection, including GraphId struct, GraphCycles class with methods for adding/removing nodes and edges, cycle detection, path finding, and stack trace management.

classes.name: GraphId
classes.description: Opaque identifier for a graph node, containing a handle of type uint64_t and comparison operators.

classes.name: GraphCycles
classes.description: Class managing a directed graph to detect cycles, with methods for node and edge management, cycle detection, path finding, and stack trace updates.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Returns the GraphId for a given pointer, assigning one if necessary.

methods.name: RemoveNode
methods.description: Removes a node and its edges from the graph based on the pointer.

methods.name: Ptr
methods.description: Returns the pointer associated with a given GraphId.

methods.name: InsertEdge
methods.description: Attempts to insert an edge between two nodes; fails if it would create a cycle.

methods.name: RemoveEdge
methods.description: Removes an edge between two nodes.

methods.name: HasNode
methods.description: Checks if a node exists in the graph.

methods.name: HasEdge
methods.description: Checks if an edge exists between two nodes.

methods.name: IsReachable
methods.description: Checks if one node is reachable from another.

methods.name: FindPath
methods.description: Finds a path from source to destination node, returning the number of nodes in the path.

methods.name: UpdateStackTrace
methods.description: Updates the stack trace for a node with a given priority.

methods.name: GetStackTrace
methods.description: Retrieves the stack trace for a node.

methods.name: CheckInvariants
methods.description: Checks internal invariants of the graph structure; used for testing.
